name: maintenance
description: Scheduled maintenance windows that suppress alerts and herald speech for planned downtime.

cli.summary: Schedule maintenance windows that mute alerts/herald per node or role

verbs.name: list
verbs.table: (.windows // .) | (if type=="array" then . else [] end) | .[] | [.id, .name // "-", .node_pattern // "*", (.starts_at | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")), (.ends_at | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")), .recur // "once", ((.enabled // true) | tostring)]

verbs.name: check
verbs.summary: Is a given node currently in any maintenance window?

verbs.name: cancel
verbs.summary: Delete a maintenance window by id
